Mali.title: Mali: Army conducts targeted strikes against armed groups in several regions
Mali.summary: Mali: the army carries out targeted strikes against armed groups in several regions These interventions are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, dedicated to the surveillance, control and security of the national territory, specifies the military command.

Mali.title: Violent armed confrontations.. Moroccan drivers face death on the roads of Mali
Mali.summary: Moroccan trucks survived a shooting in Mali yesterday, Thursday, after they tried to pass through their goods in this African country that lives under the weight of war, and this incident prompted professionals to launch a wide appeal to avoid this corridor.

Mali.title: New robberies reported on Gao-Intilit axis
Mali.summary: The robberies of transport buses are multiplying on the Gao-Intilit axis, arousing the concern of travellers. After a first attack last Tuesday, another bus was reportedly held up this Thursday on the same route. The passengers were reportedly stripped of their belongings, while their luggage and parcels were searched and ransacked.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Fama strikes several terrorist targets in the Doïla and Djénné areas
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 30 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said in a statement on Friday. According to the same source, the exploitation of precise information on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, made it possible to locate, north of the village of Talhandak, a strategic regroupment point housing armed terrorist groups as well as war material and logistics.

Mali.title: From Mali to Niger, is secret disappearance becoming a method of government in the ESA?
Mali.summary: In Mali, opponent Mountaga Tall and her son remain unaccounted for six months after their abduction. In Niger, the government admits to detaining journalist Moussa Kaka, but still refuses to indicate where and why. In both cases, relatives and lawyers do not know where the three men are locked up.

Mali.title: An opponent of the junta in Mali, victim of an enforced disappearance
Mali.summary: - HRW, October 30, 2026 Mountaga Tall and his son must be located and released More »Mountaga Tall and his son must be located and released. Six months after their abductions, Mountaga Tall, who had openly criticized the junta in Mali, and her son, Cheick Mamadou Tall, are still missing; their whereabouts are unknown and the Malian authorities remain silent .

Mali.title: Mali: Targeted army strikes against terrorist logistics
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 a series of targeted strikes against several terrorist groups in the North, Southeast and Center of the country, announced the General Staff of the Armed Forces in a statement released Friday in Bamako These combined interventions are part of the Dougoukoloko operation, dedicated to the surveillance, control and security of the national territory, reported Friday the general staff of the Malian army.

Mali.title: Terrorism tracked and neutralized: FAMa successfully strikes in Talhandak, Nangola and Djenné
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Wednesday, October 28, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, north of the village of Talhandak, a strategic regroupment point housing armed terrorist groups as well as war and logistics equipment.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist positions in several localities
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to monitor and secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 . North of the village of Talhandak, precise information made it possible to locate a major terrorist assembly point, where war materiel and logistics were stored.

Mali.title: Mali: L'armée et l'Africa corps russe déciment plus de 200 têtes de bétail près de Diéma
Mali.summary: Au Mali, plus de 200 boeufs et moutons ont été tués mercredi 28 octobre par l'armée malienne et ses partenaires russes de l'Africa Corps à Mangara, commune de Dioumara, cercle de Diéma, dans la région de Nioro du Sahel. Des habitations ont également été incendiées. C'est le deuxième incident similaire en huit jours.

Mali.title: Mali: An opponent of the Malian junta has been the victim of an enforced disappearance for six months
Mali.summary: Mountaga Tall and her son must be located and released Six months after their abductions, Mountaga Tall, who had openly criticized the junta in Mali, and her son, Cheick Mamadou Tall, are still missing; their whereabouts are unknown and the Malian authorities remain silent. Every day that goes by without news causes fear for their safety and aggravates the anguish of their family Unidentified gunmen abducted Mountaga Tall in Mali's capital Bamako on May 2.

Mali.title: DCSSA/DMHTA: the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an authority visit to both structures
Mali.summary: As part of his command tour with the staffs and service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, visited, on Thursday, October 29, 2026, the garrison of Kati, where he visited successively the Central Directorate of the Army Health Service (DCSSA) and the Directorate of Equipment, Hydrocarbons and Transport of At the DCSSA, the CEMGA was welcomed by the director of the structure, Brigadier General Guediouma DEMBÉLÉ.

Mali.title: Mali: Russian army and Africa Corps decimate more than 200 head of cattle near Diéma
Mali.summary: Mali: the army and the Russian Africa Corps decimate more than 200 head of cattle near Diéma In Mali, more than 200 cattle and sheep were killed on Wednesday 28 October by the Malian army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps in Mangara, Dioumara commune, Diéma circle, in the Nioro region of the Sahel. Homes were also set on fire. This is the second similar incident in eight days .

Mali.title: Dem/DSMIL: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an authority visit to both structures
Mali.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, made visits to the Directorate of Military Schools (dem) and the Directorate of Military Sports (DSMIL) on Tuesday, 27 October 2026. . These visits are part of his series of visits to the headquarters and service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), aimed at inquiring about their functioning and recalling the directions of the command.

Niger.title: Niger, Human Rights Watch and RSF demand Moussa Kaka's release
Niger.summary: Les deux organisations de défense des journalistes ont à nouveau réclamé la libération du correspondant de RFI au Niger, ainsi que la transparence sur sa situation. Par la rédaction de Mondafrique L’arrestation du journaliste, le 31 août, deux jours après le coup d’État manqué du 29, a d’abord été secrète. Il s’est volatilisé avec son véhicule sur la route de son domicile, après sa journée de travail dans sa radio et télévision privée Saraounia.

Niger.title: Al Shabaab Ambush in South West State; Algeria Deploys to Niger: Africa File, October 29, 2026
Niger.summary: 18 hours ago Al Shabaab Ambush in South West State; Algeria Deploys to Niger: Africa File, October 29, 2026 Contributors: Ziv Zellars and Tyler Davila Key Takeaways: - Somalia. Al Shabaab ambushed Federal Government of Somalia (FGS) forces, who had launched a counteroffensive against opposition forces in South West state, inflicting mass casualties on federal forces.
